messages.content:
You are a typical viewer scrolling TikTok at night. You have NEVER seen this show and know nothing about its story or characters.
You will read several short clips. For each clip you get exactly what plays: spoken lines and what is on screen, with times in seconds from the first frame of THAT clip (0.0 = the moment it appears in your feed). [CUT] marks a jump to a later moment.
Judge each clip ON ITS OWN, as if it were the only one you ever saw. Never use information from one clip to understand another.
Be a harsh, honest judge. Most clips are mediocre. Reserve 5 for truly scroll-stopping work.
Scores (1-5):
- hook: would 0-3 s make you stop scrolling? Judge only what happens in 0.0-3.0 s.
- standalone: could you follow who is who and what is at stake without knowing the show?
- cliffhanger: does it cut at an unresolved moment that makes you NEED the next part? 1 if it resolves or ends flat.
- tap_to_watch: overall, would you tap through to watch the show?
Return JSON only.

=== CLIP A (34.7 s) ===
[0.0-1.0] ALEXANDER (Gruff, Low): "For what?"
[1.2-4.2] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana looking up at him with deep emotional vulnerability, her eyes shimmering with tears.
[1.4-3.7] JULIANA (Trembling, Heartfelt): "For standing between me and those men."
[4.2-6.7] SCREEN: Close-up of Alexander, his piercing blue-grey eyes fixed upon her with absolute conviction.
[4.7-6.2] ALEXANDER (Unwavering, Firm): "I would do it again."
[6.7-9.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana, her lips parting as her voice wavers with emotion.
[7.2-8.9] JULIANA (Whispering, Awed): "Even if there were ten of them?"
[9.2-10.9] ALEXANDER (Deep, Resolute): "As long as I draw breath..."
[9.7-13.2] SCREEN: Tracking shot following Alexander as he strides across the muddy garden and approaches Juliana.
[11.2-14.7] ACTION: Alexander drops to one knee before Juliana, gently taking her trembling, bandaged hands into his large, weathered palms.
[12.0-14.2] ALEXANDER (Gentle, Vowing): "...no one will hurt you again."
[14.7-17.7] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana's tear-filled face, overwhelmed by his fierce devotion.
[16.0-17.4] JULIANA (Choked Up, Pained): "You cannot promise that."
[17.7-19.7] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of Alexander's intense, protective gaze locking onto hers.
[18.0-19.0] ALEXANDER (Quiet, Absolute): "I just did."
[19.7-22.2] SCREEN: Close-up of their joined hands, his rugged, scarred fingers wrapping securely around her bandaged fingers.
[19.7-22.2] ACTION: Alexander squeezes Juliana's hands reassuringly as she rests her fingertips against his skin. The scene fades to black.
[22.2-25.2] SCREEN: Medium shot in the warm, flickering firelight of the stone cottage. Juliana kneels on the stone floor beside a washbasin of water while Alexander sits quietly in a chair beside the blazing hearth.
[23.2-27.7] ACTION: Juliana wrings out a clean linen cloth from the basin and tenderly dabs at the fresh cuts and abrasions on the back of Alexander's right hand.
[25.2-28.2] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands delicately pressing the white cloth against Alexander's wounded knuckles.
[26.0-27.9] JULIANA (Tender, Reproachful): "You were bleeding last night."
[28.2-31.7] SCREEN: Medium close-up showing Alexander gazing down at her, his expression softening with unspoken affection as he gently takes hold of her wrist.
[29.2-30.5] ALEXANDER (Quiet, Fond): "So were you."
[31.7-34.7] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes, a faint, tender smile gracing her lips.
[32.2-34.7] JULIANA (Softly Teasing): "You make it very difficult to argue with you."

[1.7-4.9] CATHERINE (Taunting, Silkily): "Or has your sudden climb to power sweetened your taste already?"

[5.3-7.9] RUPERT (Flirtatious, Sly): "Only if it sweetens your disposition, Catherine."

[8.0-9.8] RUPERT (Boastful, Confident): "The estate is practically ours."
[9.9-12.2] RUPERT (Smug): "The succession papers are being finalized as we speak."
[12.3-17.1] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Catherine raising the porcelain teacup to her lips, her expression turning sharp and dismissive.
[12.5-15.8] CATHERINE (Cold, Haughty): "'Practically' is a word for beggars. I do not marry a practical Duke."
[15.9-17.2] CATHERINE (Stern, Ambitious): "I marry the Lord of Ashbury."
[17.1-22.6] SCREEN: Medium shot of Rupert striding toward the tea table, leaning forward with predatory conviction.
[17.2-18.3] RUPERT (Reassuring, Firm): "And so you shall."
[18.4-21.3] RUPERT (Dark, Conspiratorial): "Once my cousin Alexander's death is formally sealed by the Crown..."

[22.6-27.3] SCREEN: Close-up of Catherine lowering her teacup, her icy blue eyes narrowing in calculated concern.
[22.6-25.3] CATHERINE (Wary, Inquiring): "And what of the Dowager? The old woman still breathes."
[25.4-27.3] CATHERINE (Disdainful): "Her shadow still hangs over this house."

[27.3-29.9] RUPERT (Quiet, Sinister): "Her health fails more each day. The physicians are baffled."
[30.0-31.5] RUPERT (Gloating): "They call it a wasting of the lungs."
[31.2-36.3] SCREEN: Close-up side profile of Catherine bringing the teacup to her lips, savoring his words with chilling detachment.
[31.3-33.9] CATHERINE (Mock-Sympathetic, Cruel): "How tragic. The slow, quiet decline."
[34.0-36.2] CATHERINE (Scheming): "How much longer can the frail thing survive?"
[36.4-39.6] SCREEN: Medium profile of Rupert looking out the window, hands clasped behind him.
[36.5-39.5] RUPERT (Cold, Callous): "Not through the winter. I've ensured her quiet comfort."
[39.6-47.1] SCREEN: Close-up of Catherine turning her head toward the window, her lips curled in venomous disgust.
[39.7-42.0] CATHERINE (Vindictive): "Good. The village is already whispering about her."
[42.1-45.5] CATHERINE (Contemptuous): "The local peasants are like dogs, barking at every carriage that passes."
[45.6-46.9] CATHERINE (Disgusted): "They disgust me."
[47.1-53.6] SCREEN: Medium two-shot. Rupert stands over Catherine seated at the polished table, placing a gloved hand possessively near her shoulder.
[47.3-49.6] RUPERT (Dismissive, Arrogant): "They are nothing. Dirt beneath our boots."
[49.9-53.1] RUPERT (Authoritative, Promising): "They will learn their place when you wear the ducal crown."
